g.title: ad_creative_director
g.text: Ad creative-director's assistant — a real multi-agent app
SequentialAgent[ planner → ParallelAgent(shots) → audio → assembler ]; crawl personas reused via AgentTool.

g.title: cluster_pipeline
g.text: runs the four stages in order

g.title: cluster_shots
g.text: each reads shots[i] from {ad_plan} · no-ops if absent

g.title: cluster_reuse
g.text: Reused crawl personas — AgentTool(agent=…), imported verbatim (not re-authored)

g.title: user
g.text: a brand brief + a target duration

g.title: state
g.text: music_mood · shots[≤3]{ look, motion, vo_line, duration∈{4,6,8} }

g.title: g_plan
g.text: budgeted shots, one voiceover line each

g.title: gotcha_fan
g.text: ParallelAgent fans out to a FIXED list, not a runtime count
build MAX_SHOTS=3 slots; cap the plan on BOTH sides

g.title: musicprod
g.text: (Music Producer → lyria bed + gemini TTS voice)

g.title: gotcha_trim
g.text: Lyria bed ≈30s fixed · avtool mixes amix=duration=longest (no trim)
→ one local FunctionTool trims mixed audio to the video length before combine
